title: Improved Leverage Score Sampling for Constrained Active Linear Regression
abstract: arXiv:2611.23801v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: In this paper we study active learning for constrained linear regression. Given a design matrix $A\in\mathbb{R}^{n\times d}$, a constraint set $C\subseteq\mathbb{R}^d$, and query access to $b\in\mathbb{R}^n$, we seek an approximate solution to $\min_{x\in C}\|Ax-b\|_2^2$ using as few queries as possible. This problem arises in many scientific and engineering applications, and randomized leverage score sampling provides a powerful method to solve it. However, existing leverage score methods ignore the constraint or encode it through ridge regularization, suffering unfavorable query complexity for anisotropic constraint sets. We propose ellipsoid-regularized leverage scores, where we approximate the constraint set by an outer ellipsoid and use its shape matrix to bias sampling toward directions that matter under the constraint geometry. We prove that the query complexity is governed by an anisotropic effective dimension $d_{\text{eff}}(C

translated_title: 面向约束主动线性回归的改进杠杆值分数采样方法
translated_abstract: 本文研究约束线性回归的主动学习问题。给定设计矩阵 A∈R^{n×d}、约束集 C⊆R^d 以及对 b∈R^n 的查询访问，我们寻求在尽可能少的查询次数下得到 min_{x∈C}‖Ax−b‖₂² 的近似解。该问题出现在众多科学与工程应用中，随机化杠杆值分数采样为求解该问题提供了一种强大方法。然而，现有的杠杆值分数方法要么忽略约束，要么通过岭正则化来编码约束，导致在各向异性约束集上的查询复杂度不够理想。我们提出椭球正则化杠杆值分数：用约束集的一个外接椭球来近似该约束集，并利用其形状矩阵将采样偏向于约束几何下更重要的方向。我们证明查询复杂度由一个各向异性有效维度 d_eff(C) 决定。
tldr: 提出椭球正则化杠杆值分数采样，通过外接椭球的形状矩阵刻画约束集几何并将采样偏向重要方向，使约束主动线性回归的查询复杂度由各向异性有效维度决定，从而改进各向异性约束下的查询效率。
en_tdlr: We propose ellipsoid-regularized leverage scores that use an outer ellipsoid's shape matrix to bias sampling toward directions relevant to the constraint geometry, governing query complexity by an anisotropic effective dimension and improving constrained active linear regression.
